title: Add cursor pagination to the users list
description: Extracts the paging logic used by /api/users into a reusable helper. The cursor is the stringified offset of the next page; a null cursor starts from the beginning. The endpoint returns at most pageSize rows plus a cursor for the following page.

expected.note: slice()'s end index is exclusive, so `offset + pageSize - 1` drops the last row of every page. The final row of the table is unreachable: the last page always comes back one item short and the loop paging through the table never yields it.
